name: Madison County, ID
findings: Madison County has 71 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Madison County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
55% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Madison County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 31% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 62% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
